notes.title: Life is Feudal: MMO — 0.26.1.33 Patch notes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31164008/ed0c8e6c2ebdf104b8f8f09823ee37546f1e03dc.jpg[/img]

We’re excited to bring you one of the biggest patches yet! Patch 0.26.1.33 is packed with major updates, new content, and a slew of fixes, all aimed at preparing Life is Feudal: MMO for the arrival of the new map, Arden. This patch covers a wide range of game mechanics to ensure a smooth and immersive experience as we transition to this exciting new chapter.

[h2]Critical changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Weapon Crafting Rework: All player-crafted weapons (excluding primitive, ranged, throwable, and those dropped by knools) now come in three versions, each with its own unique recipe. The crafting interface has been updated with a toggle allowing players to select different weapon rarities.
[*] Armor Crafting Rework: Similarly, all armor has three versions, each tied to a unique recipe. The crafting interface now includes a toggle to select armor rarity.
[/list]

Weapons and armor have received new recipes, introducing normal, sharpened, and perfect tiers for weapons and normal, reinforced, and masterwork for armor. We've added new items required for crafting higher rarity versions, such as:

[list]
[*] Small Sharpening Stone
[*] Great Sharpening Stone
[*] Small Essence of Hardness
[*] Large Essence of Hardness
[/list]

These items are essential for creating high-rarity gear and can only be obtained from Knools. 

Our goal with these changes is to encourage players to venture beyond their claims and compete with others for end-game resources needed to craft high-tier equipment.

With newly integrated components reflecting increased item rarity, items crafted according to their tier will feature higher quality caps. We’ve also removed the requirement for toughened and case-hardened materials in weapons and armor, replacing them with iron, steel, and vostaskus for simplified crafting.

For example: 
[list]
[*] To create a normal version of a weapon with quality up to 60, you need Iron Ingots
[*] To create a sharpened version of a weapon with quality up to 80, you need Steel Ingots and a Small Sharpening Stone
[*] To create a perfect version of a weapon with quality up to 100, you need Vostaskus Ingots and a Great Sharpening Stone
[/list]

[h2]Key Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reduced Resource Requirements for Armors: Resource costs for armors have been reduced by approximately 50% across materials like silk, fiber, flax, and leather (rounded up).
[*] Minor Reductions for Other Armor Types: Resource requirements have been slightly reduced for other armor types to improve accessibility.
[*] Material Simplification: Some regional-based materials have been replaced with more accessible options. For instance, "hank of soft wool" has been replaced with "hank of wool", and "whitewood board" is now any "hardwood board".
[*] Lower Repair Costs Fix: To reduce repair costs, complex materials have been adjusted to simpler equivalents, e.g., 1 ingot in recipes may now translate to 5 bars, reducing the expense of repair.
[*] Removed Extra Ingredients for Armor: Fifth ingredients have been removed from armor crafting recipes, and the material effects have been recalculated to streamline the crafting process.
[/list]

Quality Adjustments: Items crafted with common materials now cap at a quality of 60. Sharpened and reinforced items will have a quality cap of 80 and require Small Sharpening Stone or Small Essence of Hardness. For quality above 80, crafting will require Great Sharpening Stone or Large Essence of Hardness.

[list]
[*] Guild Log: Added a new in-game chat section called "Guild Log." Accessible only to members of the same guild, this chat includes unique notifications and customization options in chat settings. Within the Guild Log, members can view activity updates, such as who has logged in or out, which items were taken from or added to specific storage, and details of who killed or was killed by whom, among other key guild activities. This logging will also assist us in the fight against cheaters (non-guild characters leave logs as well).
[*] In-Game Rules Section: Introduced a new in-game rules section for each game world. Players can access these rules when selecting a world or from a dedicated menu.
[/list]

[h2]Major Changes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Military Outposts Update: Military outposts now have the capacity of a large warehouse (70 000 stones) and allow for the selection of rally points and the number of available slots. 
[*] The intention behind these updates is to make Military Outposts as robust as guild monuments. This is designed to eliminate the need for creating fake guilds in the future. In essence, our goal is to discourage guilds from placing their monuments next to MOPs for the purpose of conducting sieges, thereby promoting fair play and more strategic gameplay.
[*] Crossbow Rework: Light Crossbow, Heavy Crossbow, and Arbalest now occupy only one slot (12) and cannot be placed in any other slot. This change addresses an exploit where the Heavy Crossbow would become ready to fire after reloading the Light Crossbow.
[*] Farming System Change: Domestic crops will now only yield their own seeds with 100% chance, without providing wild seeds. Additionally, we increased yield from: domestic flax: flax stem 16->20; wild barley, oat, rye, wheat: straw 6->8; manual max plant fiber gather per action:  15->20.
[*] Soil Weight Reduction: All soil types now weigh half as much as before, making transportation and terraforming easier.
[*] Road Construction Simplification: The slope limit for marble and slate road collapse has been increased to 2 meters for easier road building.
[*] Gate Interaction on Horseback: Players can now open and close gates while mounted using the “Open/Close the Gate” ability for gatehouses with drawbridges.
[/list]

[h2]Adjustments & Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Localization Fixes: Corrected quest texts and item names across all supported languages.
[*] Mounts Stability Fixes: Resolved issues where horses and carts would disappear when crossing server border. Also fixed an issue where horses would remain on a previous server after crossing.
[*] Guild Territory Expansion: Restricted the ability to expand guild territories using non-military outposts on servers where the guild monument is not present.
[*] Skin Application Fix: Resolved an issue where weapon skins could not be applied in some cases.
[*] Character List Bug: Fixed the issue where the character list could become empty when switching between worlds.
[*] Item Duplication Exploits: Fixed duplication bugs involving trading posts and Instanced Battles (IB).
[*] Travel Idol Cooldown: Addressed an issue where repeated use of the Travel Idol did not properly set the cooldown when teleporting to a guild location. Note that cooldowns only apply when teleporting to a guild; there is no cooldown when moving between different green zones.
[*] Durability Fixes in Arena: Prevented durability loss for items when parrying or blocking with a shield in the arena.
[*] Parry Stun Duration Adjustment: The stun duration for parrying with any weapon has been reduced from 1.5 seconds to 1.2 seconds.
[*] Tool Repair Fix: Players can now properly repair tools using the equipment ability.
[*] Jewelry Repair: Fixed an issue where players could not use the Repair ability on jewelry items when equipped with a Jeweler’s Toolkit.
[*] Guild Status Issue: Resolved a bug where guilds would not retain their ally status correctly. The error will be automatically fixed for new guilds. Existing guilds will need to take specific actions to resolve it: Send an ally request to another guild and wait for the other guild to accept the request.
[*] Jeweler's Tool Kit Fix: Added the Jeweler's Tool Kit back to the crafting recipes where it was missing.
[*] Outpost Notification: Players will now receive a clear message when attempting to reset support points while their outpost is under attack.
[*] Recipes fix: Fixed skill influence recipe for Watchtower, Stone Wall (no merlon), and Stone Wall Corner - less skill influence and more influence of materials.
[*] Building Material Changes: Regional wood is no longer needed for constructing stone fortifications. It has been replaced with standard wood in the recipes.
[*] Armor Recipe Fixes: Fixed an issue where players were unable to craft Regular Chainmail Helm and Light Scale Leggings at quality 100.
[*] Crafting Outfit Adjustment: The footwear slot lock has been disabled when any crafting outfit is equipped on the character.
[/list]

[h2]Known Issues:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Poison cannot be applied to Sharpened and Perfect weapons.
[*] Names of enhanced armor and weapon versions may differ from their base items.
[/list]

We're actively working on fixes for these issues.

Thank you for your patience and continued support! We’ve been work hard on this patch, and we know it took a bit longer than usual. This update actually includes many more changes — just for the new map, Arden, which we’ll be revealing soon! The Arden PTR is now closer than ever, so get ready!

notes.title: September 24 Minor changes
notes.notes:
Feudals, during today's maintenance, we implemented the following changes:

[list]
[*] Lag compensation has been re-enabled in the open world. We received a significant amount of feedback regarding connection quality during the test week.
[*] The web part of the game has been updated to improve stability, optimization, and to fix several issues.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued feedback!

notes.title: Hotfix 0.26.1.25 - Skill Progression & Arena Fixes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31164008/fa5919214c32e4d0b6571009cdc67e7b69c0f99b.jpg[/img]

This hotfix addresses issues with the active skill progression system and durability loss for shields during arena battles.

We appreciate your patience during the maintenance. Below are the details of the latest changes.

Changes:
[list]
[*] Active Skill Progression Fix: We've resolved a bug where active skill progression was incorrectly applied to a skill even when that skill was marked for downgrade (marked with a downward arrow).
[*] Shield Durability in Arena: Durability loss for shields during arena battles has been removed. We will later remove durability loss for parrying with weapons as well.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: 0.26.1.24 Patch Release - Enhancing Your Feudal Experience!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31164008/6cf1dad8070ecdbb37d8bedea7c42d00747d3d02.jpg[/img]

Technical maintenance has been successfully completed! Here’s everything you need to know about the latest update to Life is Feudal: MMO:

[h1]New Features[/h1]

[h2]Active-Passive Skill Progression System:[/h2]
[list]
[*] We’ve introduced a new active-passive skill progression system to enhance your gameplay experience. This system encourages players to engage in the activities they wish to improve. You will now gain additional direct experience for performing actions until you have locked a skill to level up. For example, if you're actively mining, you will not only fill the standard experience pool but also receive some direct experience in [b]Mining[/b].
[*] We have not changed the speed of passive skill progression. Experience from active actions is a bonus. According to our estimates, this will speed up leveling by [b]10% - 20%[/b], but this value depends on the skill being leveled and the chosen method of active training. 
[/list]

We look forward to your feedback on this change and are ready to adjust both the parameters of the entire system and individual skills.

[h2]New Player Buffs:[/h2]
[list]
[*] New temporary buffs are available for newcomers after character creation. These include:
[/list]
[olist]
[*] A [b]30% increase[/b] in experience gain from all sources for [b]3 days[/b].
[*] A [b]30% acceleration[/b] in skill experience distribution for [b]3 days[/b].
[/olist]

[h2]Guild Management Enhancement:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Guild leaders now have the ability to reset support points at outposts, allowing for more strategic control over guild resources. [i]You can't reset support points at buildings where an enemy outpost is set up nearby.[/i]
[/list]

We've made some changes to the Repair system. Previously, we removed the quality loss from Repair Kits, but we haven't completely abandoned the idea of implementing such a mechanic. The overall principle remains that repair serves as a means of removing resources from the game to facilitate their circulation and maintain activity at any stage of the server's life.

[h2]Repair Equipment Skill:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]The Repair Armor skill (workbench ability)[/b] has been revamped and renamed Repair Equipment. Players can now repair Weapons, Armor, Tools, Clothing, and more. Repairs require 1/4 of the crafting materials for the item. Using higher-quality workbench for repairs will restore more durability to the item. The quality of the materials used for repairs is not considered; only the quality of the workbench matters. Since most recipes use "common materials", it doesn't matter if you use the worst one, [b]the quality of the materials doesn't matter[/b]. So you can repair a q100 blacksmith hammer using a q1 iron ingot. 
[*] Note that maximum durability and quality remain unchanged after repairs. 
[/list]

[h2]Repair Kits Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Repair Kits will remain a mobile way to repair items, but they will still have a chance of losing durability when used. Now, when repairing items with Repair Kits, there will be some quality loss, but it will be much less than before.
[*] Small repair kit durability restoration 40-60 → 60-100
[*] Chance to restore with durability loss 40-80% (depending on luck)
[*] Maximum durability loss 0 → 1%
[/list]
The new version is more forgiving than the original and retains the ability to repair without losing maximum quality.  

[h3]Improvements[/h3]

[h3]Server Launcher Localization:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved localization in the server launcher to enhance user accessibility.
[/list]
[h3]Enhanced Load Times:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Game load times have been reduced to ensure a quicker and smoother entrance into the game world.
[/list]
[h3]Building Enhancements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] We have fine-tuned and improved the following structures:
[/list]
[olist]
[*] Stone Inner Gatehouse with Drawbridge
[*] Stone Gatehouse with Drawbridge
[/olist]
[list]
[*] Localization for all languages has been updated to include new structures such as:
[/list]
[olist]
[*] Watchtower
[*] Stone Inner Gatehouse with Drawbridge
[*] Stone Gatehouse with Drawbridge
[*] Stone Wall Corner
[*] Stone Wall (No Merlon)
[*] Wooden Wall Corner
[*] Wooden Wall Corner (Loophole)
[/olist]
[h3]Combat Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Stamina consumption when parry has been reduced from 7 to 3.
[*] The stun duration of enemies when successfully parrying has increased from 1 second to 1.5 seconds.
[/list]
[h3]Remove items durability loss on arena:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now you don't have to worry about damaging your equipment in the arena. Fight to your heart's content.
[/list]
[h3]Group Arena Rewards:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Rewards for group arenas have been added.
[*] Large Group Arena: 10 silver for a win, 5 silver for a loss, 7 silver for a draw.
[*] Small Group Arena: 5 silver for a win, 2 silver for a loss, 3 silver for a draw.
[/list]
[h3]Cinematics:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added an option to disable cinematics in the game menu. We really love our new logo, but now you can skip it when launching the game.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[h3]Building Production Quality Fix:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Resolved the issue where building current durability affected the quality of produced goods. Only the maximum durability of the building now influences product quality.
[/list]
[h3]Mining Exploit Fix:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Removed the possibility of abusing infinite terraforming while mining, ensuring fair play and balanced skill progression.
[/list]
[h3]Map Refresh Issue:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Resolved the issue where the game map would hang when spamming the refresh button.
[/list]
[h3]Arena Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where teammates appeared as enemies in group arenas.
[*] Updated group arena tables for clearer team separation.
[*] Addressed the issue where groups would disband after exiting group arenas.
[*] Fixed the bug where a group member received an arena invitation even if the group leader canceled the search.
[/list]
[h3]Guild Territory Bug:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where characters remained on enemy guild territory after re-logging.
[/list]
[h3]Chat System Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated the user list in chat channels so it no longer resets scrolls to the top.
[*] Fixed the issue where the chat channel participant counter worked incorrectly.
[/list]

This patch is designed to enhance your gaming experience in Life is Feudal: MMO by addressing key issues and introducing new, beneficial features. We are committed to improving your survival in the harsh medieval world, and this update is a step towards a deeper and more engaging gameplay experience.

Jump into the game and check out the new changes for yourself!



Make sure to become part of the Life is Feudal: MMO community by joining and following us on our official platforms:
[list]
[*] [url=https://discord.gg/QDrMBsvGMg]Discord[/url]

[/list]

notes.title: Life is Feudal: MMO - 0.26.1.20 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31164008/a8f093113c128b449c90024d424d8f113d2b8e5f.jpg[/img]

Well met Feudalists,

The latest update to Life is Feudal: MMO is a big one, bringing you new group arenas, guild chat, improved weapons balance, and much much more! So read on to learn more!

[h2]New Group Arenas:[/h2]
Group Arenas 2vs2 and 5vs5 have been added to the game. Here, teamwork will be much more important than individual skill.

Winners are determined at the end of the match by comparing the total points from both teams. Points are awarded in a manner similar to the classic arena system; you will not receive points for killing allies, so stabbing your teammates in the back is not recommended.

[b]Important:[/b]
Only the group leader can register the team for the group arena. 
The launch of the group arenas is in a test format, so rewards are temporarily disabled. 

We hope you enjoy this arena format and look forward to your feedback!

[h2]New Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Guild Chat:[/b] A dedicated chat for guild members is now automatically available upon joining a guild.
[*][b]Main Menu Enhancements:[/b] Added new buttons for Discord, the game Wiki, and the game Dashboard to the main menu for better accessibility.
[*][b]Durability Loss on Repair:[/b] Items and jewellery now have a chance to lose maximum durability when repaired using repair kits and through the Equipment Maintain skill. The chance to repair an item without reducing its maximum durability depends on the Luck attribute.
[*][b]Item Quality Display Button:[/b] Added a new button in the inventory to enable the numerical display of the item's quality. The button has multiple modes for convenience.
[/list]
[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Spawn Points:[/b] Corrected the incorrect spawn locations in the green zone.
[*][b]View Mode in Combat Stance:[/b] Re-enabled the free view mode in combat stance.
[*][b]Militia 90:[/b] Corrected the functionality to disarm opponents, it sends the player’s weapon into their inventory upon success. This skill is now available in the arena again.
[*][b]Inventory Quality Display:[/b] Fixed the issue where the quality display button state was not saved after closing and reopening the inventory.
[*][b]Sorting Settings:[/b] Fixed the issue where sorting and separator settings were not saved per character.
[*][b]Localization Texts:[/b] Made corrections to some localization texts.
[/list]

[h2]Improvements:[/h2]
We have encountered some players using the ownership timer to obstruct construction on neutral territory. To address this, the construction time will be longer, and the ownership timer for certain types of buildings will be reduced.
[list]
[*][b]Construction Cooldown:[/b] Reduced the ownership timer of premium buildings.
[*][b]Construction Cast Time:[/b] Increased the cast time for placing buildings. Premium decorations now take 30 seconds (up from 5 seconds) and other buildings take 25 seconds (up from 15 seconds).
[/list]

[h2]Balance[/h2]
[b]Siege Torch Modifier:[/b] Added a special damage modifier for objects to the Siege Torch, allowing it to be used more effectively to destroy objects like barricades and furniture. 

[h3]Important[/h3]
[b]With this change, the rule prohibiting barricades has been cancelled.[/b]

[b]Long-range weapons:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Long Bow:[/b] Stamina rate usage per shoot reduced from 50 to 45
[*][b]Bolt Damage (Slashing):[/b] reduced by 8%
[*][b]Heavy Bolt Damage (Piercing):[/b] reduced by 8%
[*][b]Throwing Knife Damage (Slashing):[/b] increased by 8%
[*][b]Throwing Javelin Damage (Piercing):[/b] increased by 8%
[*][b]Throwing Axe Damage (Chopping):[/b] increased by 8%
[*][b]Naphtha Pot Damage (Siege):[/b] increased by 10%
[/list]

[h2]Horses:[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Simple Warhorse:[/b] HP Regen increased from 0.012 to 0.014, Stamina Regen increased from 1 to 1.1
[*][b]Hardy Warhorse:[/b] HP Regen increased from 0.015 to 0.017, Stamina Regen increased from 1 to 1.1
[*][b]Spirited Warhorse:[/b] HP Regen increased from 0.008 to 0.01, Stamina Regen increased from 1 to 1.1
[*][b]Heavy Warhorse:[/b] HP Regen increased from 0.016 to 0.018, Stamina Regen increased from 1 to 1.1
[*][b]Royal Warhorse:[/b] HP Regen increased from 0.016 to 0.018, Stamina Regen increased from 1 to 1.1
[/list]

[h2]Weapons:[/h2]
Apart from their damage, the current set of weapons are very similar. To address this, we have decided to make the differences between the weapons more noticeable, even within the same weapon type. 

This way, different weapons of the same type will deal different types of damage, making it easier for you to choose the most effective way to defeat your opponent.

As always, these changes are not set in stone, and we will be monitoring your feedback and overall game statistics to make future adjustments if needed.

[h2]Piercing Damage[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Nordic Sword:[/b] decreased by 15%
[*][b]Knight Sword:[/b] decreased by 11%
[*][b]Light Saber:[/b] increased by 21%
[*][b]Scimitar:[/b] decreased by 6%
[*][b]GrossMesser:[/b] increased by 24%
[*][b]Claymore:[/b] decreased by 11%
[*][b]Zweihaender:[/b] increased by 44%
[*][b]Flamberge:[/b] increased by 13%
[/list]

[h2]Slashing Damage[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Nordic Sword:[/b] decreased by 44%. The piercing damage of the Nordic Sword has always been its main strength, and with this change to its slashing damage, we aim to make it less versatile.
[*][b]Knight Sword:[/b] decreased by 11%
[*][b]Light Saber:[/b] decreased by 7%
[*][b]Scimitar:[/b] decreased by 3%
[*][b]Falchion:[/b] increased by 23%
[*][b]Battle Axe:[/b] increased by 4%
[*][b]Nordic Axe:[/b] increased by 4%
[*][b]Claymore:[/b] increased by 19%. The increase in slashing damage combined with the decrease in piercing damage is intended to enhance the uniqueness of this weapon.
[*][b]Zweihaender:[/b] decreased by 32%. The reduction in slashing damage combined with the increase in piercing damage is intended to enhance the uniqueness of this weapon.
[*][b]Flamberge:[/b] increased by 1%
[/list]
				
[h2]Armors:[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]T2 Armors[/b] bonus effects (8% buff)
[*][b]T3 Armors[/b] bonus effects (15% buff)
[*][b]T4 Armors[/b] bonus effects (25% buff)
[*]Slightly reduced the weight of [b]T1 leather armor[/b] to increase mobility
[/list]

[h2]Weapon animation changes:[/h2]

[b]Nordic Sword[/b]
[list]
[*] Base Fire animation time: 1.05s -> 1.15s
[*] Base Recoil animation time: 1.05s -> 1.3s
[/list]

[/list]

[/list]

[b]Boar Spear[/b]
[list]

[/list]

[h2]Skills:[/h2]
[list]
[*] You are mine! (Berseker 90)

[*] Cooldown increased from 60 to 90
[/list]

We are continuing to work on making combat more dynamic by experimenting with animations. 
One of our focuses is combating the use of macros, and other methods, used to skip attack animations.

We hope today's changes will enhance your gaming experience, and we look forward to your feedback. More game changes are coming!

notes.title: Life is Feudal: MMO - 0.26.1.17 Hotfix
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31164008/8d4c879bbb21df606f478831af74aabdf4338380.jpg[/img]

Greetings, Feudals! The hotfix is live, tackling several crucial issues with the arena and Instanced Battles (IB) in Life is Feudal: MMO. Here’s what’s fixed:

[list]
[*] [b]Arena and IB Character Transfer Fix:[/b] Resolved an issue where characters would freeze during the "Transferring your character" process when starting an arena and IB.
[*] [b]Fix for IB Timer and Instant Completion:[/b] The IB startup has been corrected. Now, the battle preparation timer appears as intended, and the battle does not end immediately upon starting.
[*] [b]IB Connection Error Text:[/b] Corrected the error message text for failed character connections to IB.
[*] [b]Item Duplication Exploit:[/b] Fixed a game vulnerability where players could duplicate items through Instanced Battles.
[*] [b]Traveller's Idol Transfer Fix:[/b] Addressed an issue where characters could transfer to another server using the Traveller's Idol without losing inventory items. Now items will be lost as intended (except items with No Drop status).
[/list]

Last week, we also addressed several issues with skins. They should now function as intended, but if you encounter any errors, please let us know.

Thank you for your patience and continued support as we work to enhance your gameplay experience.

notes.title: Life is Feudal: MMO - Patch notes 0.26.1.16
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31164008/ef9573692135b6ff9ed19523813c3b68f639641c.png[/img]

As you might remember, we had to roll back the previous patch. Today's patch includes the previous changes (with fixes) as well as new additional changes.

Warning: Some players may find the game not launching on their devices. To resolve this issue, you need to update the following redistributable: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/windows/latest-supported-vc-redist?view=msvc-170

[h1]Key Changes:[/h1]

[h2]Map Filter Issue:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added a refresh button for the map as a temporary solution so you don't have to exit the game when the map freezes. We're still working on a permanent fix but hope to reduce inconvenience with this interim measure.
[*]At the later stages of testing, we identified a bug in which the button may not work, but in most cases, there should be no problems.
[/list]
[h2]New Teleportation Points:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Replaced teleportation points to improve travel and reduce inconveniences when teleporting between green zones.
[/list]
[h2]"Waiting for Server" Error:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed instances causing the "Waiting for Server" error. Login should now be more stable.
[/list]
[h2]Server Crash Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Investigated and rectified various scenarios leading to server crashes.
[/list]
[h2]New Buildings Added:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Stone Wall (corner)
[*]Stone Wall (no merlon)
[*]Wooden Wall (corner)
[*]Wooden Wall (corner loophole)
[*]Watchtower
[*]Stone Inner Gatehouse with Drawbridge
[*]Stone Gatehouse with Drawbridge
[/list]
[h2]Weapon and Skill Balancing:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Estoc Damage Adjustments: Reduced by 20% to improve combat balance.
[*]We see too much emphasis on the use of mines as protective structures. The following changes will help attackers quickly break down the defences of such fortresses and, among other things, will make life a little easier for ordinary miners. 
[h3]Changes to Collapse and Break Reinforce Skills:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Removed the need for tools to perform collapse and break reinforce.
[*]Reduced cast time to 8 seconds for collapse and 15 seconds for break reinforce.
[*]Experience gain reduced to 300 for collapse and 700 for break reinforce.
[/list]
[/list]
[h2]Other Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[h3]Lag Compensation Temporarily Disabled in Arenas:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Lag compensation has been disabled in arenas to collect your feedback and improve the quality of your gameplay experience.
[/list]
[*][h3]Reduced the chance of items to be destroyed after the character’s death:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Now the chance is 8% instead of 15%.
[/list]
[h3]Storage Box Change:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Capacity increased to 5000 and the number of renamings is now unlimited.
[/list]
[*][h3]Breeding Structures (stables, coops, barns) now have a common timer:[/h3]
[list]
[*]This eliminates a vulnerability that was exploited to rapidly breed animals.
[/list][/list]

These updates are aimed at making your adventures in Abella smoother and more enjoyable. Thank you for your ongoing support and feedback, which helps us improve Life is Feudal: MMO.
Enjoy your time in Abella!

notes.title: [Rollback] Life is Feudal: MMO - Patch notes 0.26.1.14
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31164008/e00a29bbe36ed6ec7fb97be132ad116bbf877cc1.jpg[/img]

[h1]Rollback Announcement[/h1]
[h3]Unfortunately, since the launch of v0.25.1.14, numerous players reported issues with the game crashing on startup.

We were able to find the source of the crash, however, preparing a fix would have taken too long. As such, we are rolling back the update.

The maintenance is scheduled to start now (15:20) and will take an additional 1 hour.
All active players will receive +1 day subscription to make up for today's disrupted service.

Read on for the original announcement below for reference. [/h3]

[b]We’re working on the map freeze error when applying filters:[/b]
We've added a map refresh button as a temporary solution so you don't have to quit the game after the map freezes. We're still working on fixing this issue, but for now, we hope to reduce the discomfort from this bug.

[b]New teleportation points:[/b]
Changed teleportation points to enhance travel and reduce inconveniences during teleportation between the green zones.

[b]"Waiting For Server" error:[/b]
Fixed occurrences of the persistent "Waiting For Server" error. Players should now experience more reliable logins.

[b]Servers crash fixes:[/b]
Investigated and rectified various server crash scenarios. 

[h3]New structures added:[/h3]
[list]

[*] Wooden Wall (corner loophole)
[/list]

These updates aim to make your adventures in Abella smoother and more exciting. Thank you for your continued support and feedback as we strive to enhance Life is Feudal: MMO.

Enjoy your time in Abella!

notes.title: Life is Feudal: MMO — 0.26.1.10 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31164008/83d470a629d2ff5f6ce911699c27f3b64c03130b.jpg[/img]

Greetings Feudal Lords!

Brace yourselves for an awesome wave of updates in Life is Feudal: MMO! This patch is packed with bug fixes, improvements, and new features to boost your gameplay experience. Check out what's new:

[h3]General Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]New Item - Storage Box:[/b] A new craftable item, the Storage Box, has been added for optimizing resource or item storage in warehouses. 
[/list]
Recipe: 10 boards, 2 metal bands, 1 lock. 
Skill Requirement: Carpentry 90.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31164008/97e9173ed7db6ec0f6433753b0d53bb3b0a94338.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]New Inventory Functionality - Splitter:[/b] This feature allows players to quickly divide items in their inventory into several equal-sized stacks.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31164008/406f03883f0631701c60145de0b19f50076b4e0f.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Character Deletion Update:[/b] Personal claims are now deleted along with the character.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes and improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Fixed Trade Journal Functionality:[/b] Transaction history is now correctly displayed in the trade journal.
[*] [b]Booster and Profession Gear Fix:[/b] Simultaneous use of the Hour of Inspiration booster and Profession Outfit now works as intended, providing the proper action speed boost.
[*] [b]Fixed item set retrieval:[/b] Sets of identical items from the Account Inventory are now transferred to the character's inventory as a complete set, rather than one item at a time.
[*] [b]Dashboard Error Fix:[/b] The "Error 01.04 You should be mmo access to view this page" in the dashboard has been resolved. This error will no longer interfere with guild or claim management.
[*] [b]Easy Anti-Cheat:[/b] Updating the anti-cheat client will help fight against cheaters.
[*] [b]Weapon Disappearance Fix:[/b] Fixed an issue where a character's weapon would disappear when picked up from the ground after fractures.
[*] [b]Updated Game Launch Preview Video:[/b] The game launch preview video has been updated.
[/list]

We are actively working on resolving the "Waiting for server" issue and optimizing the overall performance of the game servers. For this, we have added additional logging on the LIVE server, as the error does not reproduce on the test servers. Your patience and feedback are greatly appreciated as we continue to improve the game.

We hope these updates improve your gameplay experience and look forward to your feedback. Thank you for your continued support and dedication to Life is Feudal: MMO. Happy gaming!

notes.title: Life is Feudal: MMO Update 0.26.1.4 is Live!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31164008/0f593cd1735e0acbef819233a728f11919ba27ab.jpg[/img]

Hello, Feudals! 

The scheduled maintenance has been successfully completed. With a collection of both bug fixes and new feature enhancements, our team is constantly striving to make your in-game experience more comfortable and enjoyable. Let's go through the changes: 

[h3]Improvements and Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Expanded the list of Arena modes. Now, 1vs1 is not a temporary mode, but a permanent additional one. This means players can queue up for either the standard 10-person mode or the duel mode.
[*] The event notification and reward system have been improved. A special button will now appear on the player's main UI if a new game event is available or if an available reward has not been collected.
[*] A quality display marker has been added to the UI Log Warehouse and carts.
[*] The ability to rename Log Warehouse has been added.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug causing a crash during the start of Instanced Battles.
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented Steam players from opening the game Dashboard. We continue to work on improving the overall performance of the Dashboard.
[*] Fixed an issue that made it impossible to collect taxes due to the excessive total weight of coins (when waiting a long time for the tax amount to be collected).
[*] Corrections have been made in the skill descriptions in some localizations.
[*] Fixed a bug where character's hands would disappear when trying on skins.
[*] Fixed the 'Waiting for Server' error some players were encountering.
[*] Fixed a bug where a character could damage buildings in a green zone.
[*] Fixed an issue where a guild wouldn't receive a rank after setting up a monument.
[/list]

Thank you for your support and patience during the maintenance. Happy playing!

notes.title: Q&A Session: Loyalty Bonuses and Steam Release
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/VHkv2nK/Q-ASteam-main.jpg[/img]

Greetings Feudal Lords!

Yesterday, we made an important announcement about a loyalty program for players who played LIFMMO before the shutdown, as well as the game's return to Steam. From your reactions, we see that you have a lot of questions for us, and we’re here to answer you all. 

To make sure that everyone has access to all of the questions and answers, we’re starting up a public Q&A session on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/QDrMBsvGMg]Discord server[/url], and we’re inviting you to join.

[h3]How do I ask my question?[/h3]
[list]
[*]Join our Discord server
[*]Open the [url=https://discord.com/channels/999643571663675393/1118890390657961994]#ama-sessions[/url] section, 
[*]Here you’ll find a dedicated section for this Q and A.
[*]Read the questions that were posted so far and upvote/react to any questions that you feel is important.
[*]If your question has not been asked yet, write yours up.
[/list]
We’re aiming to post the answers early next week in a large (public) post.

If for any reason you cannot join our Discord server, feel free to leave your question as a reply here, we’ll then add this to the question pool.

notes.title: Friday Night Hottest Patch (0.11.4.1)
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch Notes (ver. 0.11.4.1):[/h1]

[h1]New Features and Tweaks:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Gathering plant fiber now grants a random amount of fiber per gathering action (1 to 5)
[*] Sling ammo gathering now grants a random amount of ammo per gathering action (1 to 15)
[*] Changed stair module collision mesh, which should address some exploits with stacking stairs on top of each other
[*] Luck effects from different types of sources (jewelry, blessings and 5 ingredient foods) now have separate effect slots and stack separately
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes and Optimizations:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a recently discovered item dupe with trade carts and their inventories - this should fix server crashes related to this dupe
[*] Fixed a texture streaming client crash
[*] Fixed automatic unequip of broken tools and weapons
[*] Corrected some textures and materials
[*] Added more useful data to the client logs related to material and texture errors
[/list]

— The team

notes.title: The Hotfix Tradition (0.11.1.11)
notes.notes:
[i]We seem to like to stay true to our tradition of providing hotfix patches shortly after the release. Of course we don’t plan to, and we work hard and tirelessly when releasing updates, alas, good or bad, it is already kinda our tradition! :)[/i]

This hotfix is mostly dedicated to the removal of a bug that appeared recently and has caused players, who got disconnected in the enemy realm, to appear inside the enemy town claim upon reconnection.

[h1]Patch notes (ver. 0.11.1.11):[/h1]
[h1]New features and tweaks:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Removed newcomer spawn points from the northern snow covered territories
[*] Tweaked heraldry textures on tabards
[*] Minor Demolition and Forestry abilities tweaks
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes and Optimizations:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that has caused players that DCed in an enemy realm claim to appear inside the enemy town claim
[*] Tweaked multithreaded calculation algorithms. Should be slightly more stable and faster now.
[*] Fixed Telmun world description in the Ferryman dialogue
[*] Changed primary stat for Demolition to Willpower
[/list]
— The team
